entries.name: title
entries.label: Title
entries.description: Trip name / member's chosen name / schedule item title / research item title.

entries.name: body
entries.label: Notes
entries.description: Freeform note text -- the trip's own description, a schedule item's detail, or a research item's write-up (what you learned about this place/route).

entries.name: kind
entries.label: Kind
entries.description: What this row IS -- the single discriminator every view filters on. `trip` = the one root row; `member` = a person on the trip; `schedule` = a dated/timed plan item; `research` = a gathered note, link, or candidate place (station, food, lodging, activity) evaluated before or during planning.

entries.name: type
entries.label: Sync type
entries.description: Compatibility discriminator for the SHARE pipeline only (isan's share_sink.dart levelMayPush checks Dispatch's `type` vocabulary, not this app's own `kind`). Stamped 'note' on research-kind rows only, mirroring tripboard's note-kind stamping. Never shown in the record editor.

entries.name: status
entries.label: Status
entries.description: For a schedule item: idea (unconfirmed) / confirmed / done. Unused on research rows.

entries.name: rating
entries.label: Rating
entries.description: For a research item: how this candidate compares against alternatives -- lets a place/station/route research row double as a comparison, not just a bookmark.

entries.name: date
entries.label: Date
entries.description: For a schedule item: when it happens. Drives the Schedule calendar.

entries.name: endDate
entries.label: End date
entries.description: Optional multi-day schedule item end date.

entries.name: timeLabel
entries.label: Time
entries.description: For a schedule item: a time-of-day label (e.g. 18:00).

entries.name: place
entries.label: Place
entries.description: For a schedule or research item: a place/station name.

entries.name: category
entries.label: Category
entries.description: Optional free-text tag -- for research rows, e.g. 'station', 'food', 'lodging', 'activity', 'route'.

entries.name: url
entries.label: Link
entries.description: Optional reference link for a research item (listing, article, map link, booking page, timetable) or a schedule item (booking confirmation).

entries.name: lat
entries.label: Latitude
entries.description: For a schedule or research item: pin location. Only rows with both lat and lon set show on a map.

entries.name: lon
entries.label: Longitude
entries.description: For a schedule or research item: pin location. Only rows with both lat and lon set show on a map.

entries.name: assignee
entries.label: Assigned to
entries.description: For a schedule item: which member (a kind=member entry) is responsible for confirming/booking it.

entries.name: author
entries.label: Added by
entries.description: Which member (a kind=member entry) created this row -- stamped at creation from the per-install `krtravelplanMemberId` setting, NOT from sign-in identity. Empty means the device hadn't picked a member yet -- shown as 'Unattributed', not an error or a raw id.

entries.name: initials
entries.label: Badge
entries.description: For a member: a short (1-3 character) badge shown next to their name and on every row they add -- AUTO-DERIVED from the typed name (engine primitive `flutterboard/lib/src/data/text_transforms.dart`'s `initials`, wired via this column's `rules.deriveFrom`/`deriveFn`) as soon as the name is saved, e.g. 'AK' for 'Alex Kim', 'M' for a one-word name like 'Madonna', and the given-name syllables for a Korean full name (e.g. '철수' from '김철수'). Still fully editable -- type your own badge and it's kept from then on; clear it back to blank and save to return to auto-derive. Two members may end up with the same badge regardless; the member's own chip color and emoji disambiguate.

entries.name: color
entries.label: Color
entries.description: For a member: their chip color.

entries.name: emoji
entries.label: Emoji
entries.description: For a member: their chip emoji.

entries.name: updatedAt
entries.label: Updated
entries.description: The engine's own auto-stamped per-row write time (ISO-8601, stamped by the reserved key name regardless of declared column type). DISPLAY-ONLY -- LWW-reserved, silently overwritten on every save, never listed as an addRow/editable value.

entries.name: createdBy
entries.label: Created by (sync)
entries.description: Signed-in PocketBase user id when signed in, else this install's stable local actor id ($playerId) -- stamped at creation on every addRow action -- used ONLY by the sharing pipeline's per-row 'own row' gate, so a commenter-level collaborator can push their own research note. Separate from `author` (this app's own member-attribution column, which must never key off sign-in). Never shown in the record editor.

relations.name: fromId
relations.label: From
relations.description: The source node of this relationship (the trip root, for every edge in v1).

relations.name: toId
relations.label: To
relations.description: The target node of this relationship (the member/schedule/research item it links in).

relations.name: type
relations.label: Relationship
relations.description: `contains` is the only edge type v1 needs: structural trip-root -> item, walked by the share pipeline's subtree closure.
